packages.title: shared api calendar-date helper
packages.brief: NEW common/calendar-date.ts exports startOfCalendarDay(date, timeZone) [extracted byte-for-byte from invoices.service.ts:69-89, args reordered], endOfCalendarDay(date, timeZone) [DST-safe offset-correction derivation — see build-plan.md's 'Exact code' section and its documented divergence from the ruling's literal 'add 24h then startOfCalendarDay' description, which does not hold for negative-UTC-offset zones], resolveTenantTimezone(config) [falls back to schema default America/New_York, not UTC]. invoices.service.ts deletes its private copy and updates its 4 call sites (:489,:628,:2412,:2637) to the new arg order. analytics.service.ts's accumulateRunMetrics (:335-353) gains a tenantTimezone param and calls endOfCalendarDay instead of setUTCHours(23,59,59,999); both call sites (:400 getRoutePerformance, :447 getDriverPerformance) resolve the tenant's timezone ONCE per call via a new private helper, before their existing findMany.

packages.title: GPS DTO + persistence
packages.brief: post-location.dto.ts gains an additive optional accuracy field (@IsOptional @Type(Number) @IsNumber @Min(0), no @Max — schema column is unbounded Decimal(8,2)), inserted after the existing speedKph block. drivers.service.ts's recordLocation (:105-116) create() call gains `accuracy: dto.accuracy`. routes.service.ts's latestLocation reader is explicitly NOT touched (F11's file, out of scope).

packages.title: mobile calendar-date helper + call sites
packages.brief: NEW lib/calendar-date.ts: the byte-identical-with-web pure helpers (calendarDateFromIso, isoFromCalendarDate, calendarDayBounds, plus the 3 private helpers readCalendarParts/addUtcCalendarDays/localMidnightUtc — exact bodies in build-plan.md's 'Exact code' section) plus `export { fmtCalendarDate } from './format-date'` (mobile already has one at format-date.ts:25 — re-export, never reimplement). exceptions.tsx:42-43,58-65 replaced with calendarDayBounds(deviceTimeZone) calls (Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone), matching the driver route screen's device-local semantics. licenses.tsx:84's `new Date(`${expiresAt}T23:59:59`).toISOString()` replaced with `isoFromCalendarDate(expiresAt.trim())`.

packages.title: mobile GPS sentinel mapping
packages.brief: NEW lib/location-sentinels.ts exports normalizeLocationSample({accuracy,speed,heading}) mapping any negative-or-null value to undefined (exact code in build-plan.md). location-tracker.native.ts's LocationPayload interface gains `accuracy?: number` and heading/speedKph become `number | undefined`; both payload-building sites (:32-39 the defineTask callback, :78-85 startLocationTracking) call normalizeLocationSample before building the postLocation payload, reading expo-location's existing `.coords.accuracy` (no new capture logic, no new dependency).

packages.title: web calendar-date helper + 8 sites
packages.brief: NEW lib/calendar-date.ts: the same byte-identical pure helpers as mobile's, plus `export { fmtCalendarDate } from './formatting'` (fmtCalendarDate stays IN formatting.ts, never moved). formatting.ts's fmtCalendarDate (:55-65) gains an additive 3-arg overload (locale, Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) for the two styled sites — every existing 1-arg call is byte-identical in output (unchanged branch). EditRunModal.tsx: delete formatLocalDate (:17-23); read the date field via calendarDateFromIso, write it via isoFromCalendarDate, and only include scheduledDate in the PATCH when `date !== initialDate` (fixes both the local-getter misread AND the unconditional-echo destructive write in one change). The 7 display sites swap toLocaleDateString/local fmtDate for fmtCalendarDate at exactly the cited lines; deliveries/page.tsx keeps its createdAt fallback on fmtDate (a timestamp, not a calendar date); finance/reports/page.tsx branches on row type (only INVOICE rows are calendar dates per the discovery report's correction of the register's overstatement).

packages.title: D4 repair script
packages.brief: NEW repair-f25-licence-dates.mjs: safety model copied from repair-f11-stranded-orders.mjs (dry-run default via read-only transaction, one tx per row with in-transaction re-read, JSONL before-state log to local-assets/, refuses a non-railway/routeflow database without --force-nonprod) combined with enable-developer-mode.mjs's test-tenant gate (assertTestTenant from scripts/lib/test-tenants.cjs; a live tenant needs --live-tenant-override + the readline type-back confirm). targets.behavior: endOfCalendarDay is the tenant-tz day end, DST-safe
on-time compares against the tenant-tz day end, not UTC
isoFromCalendarDate yields UTC midnight, never local
calendarDayBounds matches the driver-screen semantics on a DST day
recoverCalendarDay interprets the stored instant in the tenant tz
